testsuite.name: workshop.vfx.math.core.FrameTest

testcase.name: Constructor accepts right-handed orthonormal triples and rejects everything else
transportY follows a direction sweep without twist; naive alignY flips by about pi through the hint (negative control)
fromHeading degeneracy: vertical heading, zero heading, zero or parallel up hint
toWorld / toLocal are inverse and use the frame axes as columns
transportY: random walks stay valid; zero axis keeps the previous frame; antiparallel stays finite
alignY/alignZ degeneracy: parallel, antiparallel, zero and non-finite hints or axes (M0: robustness)
M0 audit item 2: Astral's (right, up, forward) basis is left-handed; fromHeading's (right, up, back) is right-handed
fromHeading: facing each compass direction gives the correct right, up and back axes
alignY/alignZ: right-handed orthonormal, axis honoured, hint lies in the x-y plane (10,000 random)

testsuite.system-out: [M1 transport report] worst per-step twist: transport = 1.1102230246251568E-16 rad, naive alignY = 3.141592653589793 rad
